title: Packaging, labels, records and a price that pays

say: Packaging, labels, records, and a price that pays.
This is the video for Module 3 of Small-Scale Food Processing.
You can make a safe product and still fail. The pack may let in moisture and oxygen, which make dry food soft, mouldy or rancid.

say: Choose packaging for what your product fears most. Chips fear moisture and oxygen, so laminated foil pouches protect them best. Thin nylon is only fine for selling the same day.
Then seal well. First, wipe the inside top of each pouch so no powder, oil or crumbs sit in the seal line.

panel.heading: Sealing well
items: Wipe the inside top of each pouch
Test the sealer on an empty pouch
Press out extra air gently
Squeeze and check every seal
Jars: wash, dry, wipe rim, close at once

say: Test the impulse sealer on an empty pouch. Too low gives a weak seal, too high melts holes.

say: A best before date is about quality. A use by or expiry date is about safety. Your shelf life must come from evidence, not from copying another brand.
For example, Kemi in Ibadan keeps 8 sealed packs of chips, half in plastic and half in foil, stored the way a shop would.

panel.heading: Kemi's real shelf-life test
items: Keep 8 sealed packs as retained samples
Week 3: plastic packs less crisp
Week 6: plastic soft; foil still crisp
Best before: 3 weeks plastic, 6 weeks foil

say: She opens one at each check. By week 3, the plastic packs are slightly less crisp.

panel.heading: Kemi's real shelf-life test
items: Keep 8 sealed packs as retained samples
Week 3: plastic packs less crisp
Week 6: plastic soft; foil still crisp
Best before: 3 weeks plastic, 6 weeks foil

say: By week 6, the plastic packs are soft and stale, while the foil packs are still crisp.

say: Your label is a promise and a legal document. It needs the name of the food, ingredients from largest to smallest, and allergens such as groundnuts shown clearly.
Add the true net weight, your name and address, dates, a batch number, storage advice and your NAFDAC number once you have it.

panel.heading: What goes on the label
items: Name of the food and ingredients
Allergens shown clearly, like groundnuts
True net weight
Producer name and full address
Dates and batch number
Storage advice and NAFDAC number

say: To grow into supermarkets, register your business with the Corporate Affairs Commission first. NAFDAC has a desk for small producers. Always confirm current fees and steps with NAFDAC directly.

panel.heading: Registration and honest labels
right: Print a number you do not have
Pay agents to get a number fast

say: Never print health claims like cures ulcer, never print a NAFDAC number you do not have, and never pay someone to get a number fast for cash. False labels can lead to seizure of goods.

panel.heading: Registration and honest labels

say: Many producers count only the raw food. Full cost adds packaging, energy, milling fees, transport, your labour, and a 10% allowance for overheads and waste.
Uche's cassava costs about 20,000 naira, and her 2 days of labour are valued at 10,000 naira. Her whole batch costs about 50,050 naira for 40 bags.

card.title: Uche's garri: cost and price per bag

say: So each bag costs her about 1,251 naira.

card.title: Uche's garri: cost and price per bag

say: At a retail price of 1,600 naira, she makes about 349 naira profit per bag, on top of paying herself.

card.title: Uche's garri: cost and price per bag

say: A shop wants to buy at about 1,400 naira. That is still above her cost, but her margin is only about 11%. So she must watch waste and costs closely.

card.title: Uche's garri: cost and price per bag

say: To remember. Choose packaging for what your product fears. Check every seal. Set shelf life from your own retained samples. Label truthfully, with allergens clear.
And keep a batch record and a costing sheet, so your wholesale price always stays above full cost.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Pack for your product's main enemy
Keep seal lines clean; check every seal
Shelf life comes from your own tests
Label truthfully; declare allergens
Full cost includes labour, waste and overheads

say: Now seal at least four packs as retained samples and start your shelf-life log. Draft your label with space for the NAFDAC number, and build a costing sheet with retail and wholesale prices.
